image_policy: Download Commons width-600 thumbnail where available; preserve aspect ratio, orient from EXIF, RGB lossless PNG, longest side <=600, no upscaling/cropping; identical bytes to all five models. Original source URL and dimensions retained. Images with a side below 280 are centered on neutral-gray padding to minimum 280 per side, without further resizing; all five models rerun on the same padded bytes.
duplicates: Reject exact PNG SHA256 matches, repeated Commons page IDs, and dHash Hamming distance <=2.
human_review: True category is blank. Review once per image; permit Ambiguous, Other, NotAerial, Unusable. No accuracy until human labels exist.
